scientific_integrity: The mathematical statement, proof, limitations, and executable verifier are bundled; the classification is derived from and does not purport to replace established categorical duality.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty discrete-frame full-team algebras with designated core, not arbitrary Kripke-frame inquisitive algebras or plain Heyting reducts.

Underlying finite duality and finite-set transformation theory are established prior results; the new claim is the explicit partition-indexed retract image lattice with Dedekind grading and its exact morphism statistics.
The finite computation is bounded (world sizes up to four, and operation checks for cross-size homomorphisms up to three); the general proof is independent of computation.
No independent audit, external formal proof, or comprehensive unpublished-work originality search has been conducted.
title: Bell–Dedekind retract calculus for finite full-team inquisitive and dependence algebras
